title: Chef John's Chicken a la King
description: This classic comfort food recipe is easy to adapt to your taste. Use leftover roast chicken or a store-bought rotisserie chicken, and serve the creamy sauce over pasta, toast, rice, or mashed potatoes.
ingredients: Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
0.33333334326744 cup creme fraiche or heavy cream

steps.text: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms and salt. Saute until mushrooms release their moisture. Continue cooking until moisture evaporates and mushrooms begin to brown, 8 to 10 minutes. Add shallots; cook and stir just until shallots soften, 3 or 4 minutes.

Reduce heat to medium. Stir in flour to coat the mushrooms; cook until flour begins to turn golden, about 5 minutes, to form roux. Add peppers; cook and stir about 1 minute. Pour in sherry wine; allow to sizzle about 30 seconds. Stir in stock. Raise heat to medium-high and bring to a simmer. When it starts to bubble, reduce heat to medium-low and cook until slightly thickened, 10 to 15 minutes stirring occasionally. Add nutmeg and cayenne pepper.

Stir in thyme, parsley, cream, and chicken. Reduce heat to low and cook until chicken is heated through, about 5 minutes. Check seasonings and adjust as needed. Top each serving with some chopped fresh chives.

video.description: Watch how to make one of Chef John's favorite, classic comfort foods-Chicken a la King. First saute mushrooms and shallots in butter, then add flour to make a roux that smells like a pie crust. Dump in diced peppers and stir to coat with the roux. A splash of sherry wine deglazes the pan before chilled chicken stock is added and the heat is raised to a simmer. Season and simmer some more until the mixture starts to thicken. Stir in chicken and serve over your favorite carb as soon as it's heated through. It's every bit as delicious and comforting as it looks!
